Standard: Propulsion technical data are current, accurate, and consistent with verified propulsion design analysis and test results. The following items are documented in the identified technical data and technical manuals to enable continued AW: Published Air Vehicle Flight Manual: a. Propulsion system operating limit. b. Normal operating procedures. c. Emergency procedures. d. Operating restrictions. e. Installed performance at critical performance conditions of the air vehicle IAW 7.2. Published Propulsion System Technical Orders and Technical Manuals: a. Propulsion system maintenance requirements and procedures. b. Propulsion system inspection requirements and procedures. c. Propulsion system serviceability and repair limits. d. Propulsion system life-limited components and associated replacement requirements. e. Post-maintenance propulsion system test requirements. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review flight manual and propulsion system TOs and technical manuals to verify required content is present and is consistent with engineering source data.
